subject: STAT101
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos covering all 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The English selections are from highly-regarded educational channels with very high view counts, directly addressing the specified student difficulties. For Arabic, coverage was also complete, though for Welch's t-test, the most conceptually direct videos were ineligible due to low views, leading to the selection of a popular, eligible software tutorial that covers the necessary context.

coverage.note: Most candidates were either general introductions or failed the duration or view count gates. Only one candidate was fully eligible.
The most conceptually relevant videos were ineligible due to low view counts. Selected an eligible, high-quality SPSS tutorial that covers the context of choosing this test.
